svg.aria-label: ipm gamma(3,4) edges: event → concept via expresses. The triangle on the right keeps these elements and greys the rest.
svg.title: ipm γ(3,4): e → c X
svg.text: one of the eleven legal edges of the γ(3,4) triangle
— between two events the bare arrow already means leads-to, so part-of and expresses must name themselves.
